name: Saving a connection clears the stale pin in BOTH layers
prose: project settings merge over global, so a leftover `apiKeyEnv` in `~/.magentra/settings.json` wins straight back. The wizard now clears it wherever it lives, via one helper rather than a copy of the `contextWindow` clear.
invariant: Saving a connection clears a stale apiKeyEnv pin in BOTH the project and global layers, through one helper.
